name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 102 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 27% fewer than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 102 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 27 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli forces ended a ten-day operation in Hebron, withdrawing after detaining residents and threatening a broader West Bank offensive, while the IDF killed six Hamas operatives, including two who took part in the Oct 7 attack, and a separate strike in Gaza City killed one person and wounded five. Israeli forces killed four Palestinians in Gaza and a fifth died of wounds, and they arrested six West Bank Palestinians accused of building rockets to launch at Israel. A UN rights office warned of a deepening displacement nightmare in Gaza, and a West Bank school fortified its defences against settler violence. Al Jazeera journalist was released in the occupied West Bank and Al Jazeera condemned an extension of its ban. The UCDP recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker avsluttet en ti-dagers operasjon i Hebron, trakk seg tilbake etter å ha arrestert innbyggere og truet med en bredere offensiv på Vestbredden, mens IDF drepte seks Hamas-operatører, inkludert to som deltok i angrepet 7. oktober, og et separat angrep i Gaza-by drepte én person og såret fem. Israelske styrker drepte fire palestinere i Gaza og en femte døde av sårene, og de arresterte seks palestinere på Vestbredden anklaget for å bygge raketter for avfyring mot Israel. Et FN-rettskontor advarte om en dypere fordrivelsesmareritt i Gaza, og en skole på Vestbredden styrket sine forsvar mot bosettervold. Al-Jazeera-journalist ble løslatt på den okkuperte Vestbredden og Al-Jazeera fordømte en forlengelse av forbudet. UCDP registrerte 21 440 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
